summary.text: David Spiller is a Republican state representative from Texas House District 68 who has represented the district since 2021 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is an attorney from Jacksboro.

paragraphs.text: David Spiller lives in Jacksboro, Texas, and his career experience includes working as an attorney with the law firm of Spiller & Spiller and owning Spiller Title.
Ballotpedia lists his 2023-2024 committee assignments as House State Affairs, Appropriations and General Investigating.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026, and faces Democrat Jasmine Henderson in the general election.
